0022600225.text: The Warriors (8-3, second in the Pacific and 1.5 games back, fourth in the West) are riding an eight-game winning streak and have gone 8-2 over their last ten, while the Rockets (8-3, second in the Southwest and one game back, sixth in the West) are 7-3 over their last ten and have won their last game. Golden State is missing Brandon Williams, Gary Payton II, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody and Will Richard, and Houston is without Clint Capela and Steven Adams. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Warriors lost their season series 1-2, including a 117-116 loss in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
